semantics.history: full single-branch, no shallow/filter; 257 tracked files; --no-local
semantics.cold: fresh destination and full checkout; OS/page/provider caches uncontrolled
semantics.pairing: SEED Fisher-Yates backend block order per repetition; three sequential correlated edits
semantics.native: real local API/SQLite/LocalGit; no WorkOS/Artifacts; normal Git unavailable without harness
semantics.transport: benchmark-only LocalGit info/token wrapper and loopback git http-backend; app auth/ACL rechecked per request; only private task writes
semantics.bypasses: zero Git data client filesystem remotes for harness; fixture creation/verification local; original API read token reports filesystem path; no canonical seeding/publishing
semantics.complete: direct same-world stopwatch: credential refresh (harness), edit/add/commit/push/fetch/full checkout, all-file/history/ref verification, app open/log/tree/file (harness)
semantics.workflow: direct same-world stopwatch edit/add/commit/push/fetch/full checkout; HTTP/credential checks included in transport; credential issuance before stopwatch
semantics.bodyCounters: HTTP entity bodies only, not headers/TLS/wire/provider metering; includes in-memory credential JSON lengths without recording values
semantics.resources: Git client /usr/bin/time process-tree counters; HTTP server CGI children separately; Node process CPU/RSS includes controller and server, not attributed per provider; overlapping counters must not be added
